per_ku.cambridge_section: Intermediate/Academic: individual human being; translations include 人

excluded_sisters: w_0266_person_ku02 morphology: same glosses, but a morphology KU, not a competing sense. Excluded by ku_type; creates join ambiguity only, resolved by exact ku_id.
discrimination.forces_target: 'One person' denotes a single individual; no role, character, or body sense is available in this sentence.

notes: Teaching value: 'One person' isolates countability and the individual sense; the waiting-outside scene is a prototypical A1 context; all other words are A1.
per_ku.triage_comparison: AGREE (triage: acceptable). This certification adds sense-level discrimination and Cambridge verification the triage did not perform.

per_ku.cambridge_section: TIME AVAILABLE: 'an amount of time that you have available to do something'; also MINUTES/DAYS/YEARS measured existence

excluded_sisters: w_0049_time_ku02 occasion （次；时候）: 'need more time to finish' is about amount available, not an occasion or point.
w_0049_time_ku03 collocation: same glosses, collocation type, not a competing sense; join ambiguity only.
w_0049_time_ku04 period/era （时期；时代）: no era or historical period in context.
w_0049_time_ku05 schedule/timing （安排时间；计时）: the sentence is not about arranging or measuring by clock; it is about needing a larger amount.
discrimination.forces_target: 'more time to finish' can only be read as a larger amount of available duration.

per_ku.example_en: We need more time to finish.
per_ku.example_zh: 我们需要更多时间才能完成。
notes: Teaching value: teaches the uncountable duration use and the high-frequency pattern 'need more time'; all other words A1.

CONDITION (not a semantic failure): the correct answer expands the gloss with context interpretation ('完成事情所需的时长'); it is assessable ONLY under the pack's alternative-accepting policy. An exact-string scorer would fail it. Scorer implementation remains an open gate.
Level note: Cambridge levels the duration/available senses A2/B1 (point-in-time is A1); the pack's A1 label is word-level. Do not surface A1 as this sense's level.
per_ku.translation_quality: PASS: accurate and natural; 才能完成 faithfully renders the need-for-completion modality.
per_ku.triage_comparison: AGREE (triage: acceptable). This certification adds the discrimination matrix, the Cambridge section identification, and the scorer condition.

per_ku.cambridge_section: Knowledge/awareness: 'I don't know', 'She knew something was wrong' (be aware that something is true)

excluded_sisters: w_0041_know_ku02 be familiar with （认识；熟悉）: 'the answer' is not a person, place, or field to be acquainted with.
w_0041_know_ku03 grammar: same glosses, grammar type, not a competing sense; join ambiguity only.
w_0041_know_ku04 recognize （辨认出；意识到）: the sentence states possession of the answer, not perceptual recognition of something encountered.
discrimination.forces_target: 'I know the answer' can only be read as possessing the information.

notes: Teaching value: the prototypical school-context use; the shortest and most frequent pattern of the six; ideal A1 first example for this verb.
per_ku.triage_comparison: AGREE (triage: acceptable). This certification adds discrimination against the familiarity and recognition sisters.

per_ku.cambridge_section: plural noun (PERSONS): 'There were a lot of people there', 'Some people were hurt'; distinct from noun [C] (NATION) and verb [T] (PERSONS)

excluded_sisters: w_0057_people_ku02 nation/community （民族；人民）: 'Many people live here' carries no national or community identity; it is a plain plural of persons.
w_0057_people_ku03 grammar: same glosses, grammar type, not a competing sense; join ambiguity only.
discrimination.forces_target: 'Many people' as the subject of 'live here' can only be read as persons collectively.

per_ku.evidence_grade: STRONG (upgraded in this certification: the /us/ dictionary page renders the plural noun (PERSONS) section explicitly, distinct from NATION)
notes: Teaching value: pairs with person to teach singular/collective contrast (person vs people); 'Many people live here' is a prototypical residence statement; all other words A1.
per_ku.translation_quality: PASS: accurate and natural; 许多人 correctly reflects 'Many'.
per_ku.triage_comparison: AGREE (triage: acceptable). This certification adds the PERSONS-vs-NATION section distinction the triage did not check.

per_ku.cambridge_section: verb [I] (SAY WORDS), A1: 'to say things or speak to someone'; Chinese 讲话，谈话

excluded_sisters: w_0139_talk_ku02 discussion/speech （谈话；讲话）: the example uses talk as a VERB ('We talk'), not the noun 'a talk'.
w_0139_talk_ku03 discuss formally （讨论；谈判）: habitual evening conversation is not formal discussion or negotiation.
w_0139_talk_ku04 grammar: same glosses, grammar type, not a competing sense; join ambiguity only.
discrimination.forces_target: 'We talk every evening' can only be read as habitual conversing.

notes: Teaching value: teaches the habitual present and the verb use, with the noun use (ku02) available as a follow-up contrast; all other words A1.

Runtime IPA observation (carried from B215, not a content defect): the Runtime's /tˈɔk/ is UK-leaning; the pack's /tɑːk/ is the correct Cambridge US form and is the value this certification endorses for display.
per_ku.triage_comparison: AGREE (triage: acceptable). This certification adds verb-vs-noun discrimination and the Cambridge A1 SAY WORDS section.

per_ku.cambridge_section: A1: 'in, at, or to this place'; Chinese 在这里, 到这里; Cambridge's own pattern 'Come here' parallels the pack sentence

excluded_sisters: w_0099_here_ku02 at this point （在这一点；此时）: 'Please come here' is spatial (to this place), not discourse-deictic or temporal 'at this point'.
discrimination.forces_target: 'come here' in an imperative can only be read as directional 'to this place'.

notes: Teaching value: the prototypical classroom imperative; teaches the directional adverb in its most frequent pattern; all other words A1.

The pack gloss ('at or to this place') is the Cambridge-exact form and fits this directional example better than the Runtime's narrower 'in this place'; same sense, broader paraphrase, not a different sense.
per_ku.triage_comparison: AGREE (triage: acceptable). This certification adds the directional-vs-static branch analysis and the Cambridge A1 section citation.

production_ready_verdict: NOT GRANTED. Semantic certification is necessary but not sufficient for production. PRODUCTION_READY remains 0 for all six records, exactly as the triage decided. Nothing in this certification authorizes SRS writes, playable-pool promotion, official Runtime mutation, or user-learning-state changes.
remaining_blockers: 1. Authoritative row-level mapping recorded in the crosswalk (or an equivalent authority artifact): the matches are factually verified by direct Runtime lookup (B215), but the crosswalk file still records reviewed: []. The registration authority must record them; this certification deliberately does not write crosswalk entries, to keep semantic certification separate from identity certification.

2. Assessment scorer implementing the pack's alternative-accepting policy (accept any precise equivalent, no exact-string requirement). Until implemented, the time record's expanded answer and any learner paraphrase risk false failures.
3. Signed/versioned overlay manifest with the exact Runtime SHA-256, record count, coverage, source attribution, immutable KU identities, and release decision, plus fail-closed behavior tests.
4. Isolation regression tests before any preview wiring beyond the existing separate preview page: flag-off no-op, no SRS write path reachable, base Runtime bytes unchanged.
5. Production display license/clearance decision by the release authority.
6. Runtime end-to-end verification inside the official learning flow (the parallel preview-page acceptance covered the separate preview page only, not the official flow).
7. Human-editor signoff, if release policy requires it: this is an AI second-party certification, not a human signature.

semantic_certification.pending_definition: PENDING means an unresolved semantic doubt about the record itself. No record is PENDING: every semantic question raised during review was resolved by the discrimination analysis or the Cambridge evidence. All open items are non-semantic gates (identity recording, scorer, manifest, tests, license, e2e, human signoff) and are listed under remaining_blockers, not as PENDING records.
semantic_certification.verdict: GRANTED (content layer only) for all six records: person, time, know, people, talk, here.
